title: How to Cancel Xfinity Internet: Steps, Fees and Equipment Return (2026)
description: How to cancel Xfinity internet: the phone, scheduled-call and store routes Xfinity lists, early termination fee rules, how to return equipment, and what to try first. Checked November 27, 2026.
lead: The routes Xfinity lists, the fee rules to check, how to return equipment, and what to try before you cancel.
short_answer: Xfinity's cancel page lists three routes: call 1-800-XFINITY (1-800-934-6489), schedule a call from your account, or visit an Xfinity Store. Check your agreement for a minimum term before you cancel, return your equipment at a store or with a prepaid UPS label, and keep the receipt. If price is the reason, try the retention call first.

sections.body_html:
1. Line up the replacement first. Book your next provider's install date before you cancel so you are not without internet.
  2. Check for a minimum term. Sign in, open the Account icon, then Account and Identity, then Legal agreements. Xfinity says you may be charged an early termination fee if you end service before a minimum term is over.
  3. If price is the reason, call first. A bill that went up can often be lowered. See the Xfinity call script. You may not need to switch.
  4. Save your records. Download your last bill and note your account number.

sections.h2: How to cancel: the routes Xfinity lists
sections.body_html:
1. By phone: Xfinity's cancel page says to call 1-800-934-6489.
  2. Scheduled call: Xfinity's cancel page says you can schedule a call from your account sign-in.
  3. In person: visit an Xfinity Store. Xfinity links store locations from its cancel page.

Third-party sites list other routes such as chat or a mailed request, but we did not confirm them on xfinity.com. We are not listing hours because we could not confirm them from Xfinity.

Xfinity's community help says you may be charged an early termination fee if you end service before the minimum term is over. It says the fee does not apply if you downgrade, or if you have a bundle and remove all but one service. It says the fee does apply if you move to an area Comcast does not serve, and that transferring service to a new Comcast address avoids it. It lists waivers for active-duty military deployment (with documentation) and for the death of the account holder. Xfinity's 5-year price guarantee page says there is no annual contract and you can cancel anytime without penalty. We did not find the fee amount published by Xfinity, so ask for the exact figure and how it is calculated before you agree to cancel.

1. Xfinity Store: hand the equipment to a representative and get a receipt. Xfinity says it is removed from your account right away.
  2. Prepaid UPS label: use the label from a recent Xfinity shipment or print one at xfinity.com/returns (you need your Xfinity ID). Pack the device, remote and power cord, and drop it off where UPS shipments are accepted. Xfinity says to allow up to two weeks for the return to show on your account.
  3. WiFi extenders, cameras and Xfinity Mobile products have separate steps.

Xfinity says you may see charges on your final bill for rental equipment that has not been returned; we did not find a return deadline or an amount published. Keep your receipt or tracking number, and check your final bill for equipment charges.

Check your final bill for equipment charges and any early termination fee. If something looks wrong, dispute it with Xfinity in writing and keep your receipt. If you are choosing a new provider, compare providers at your address and check the price after the promotion. Our promo-end reminder can call you before the new provider's price goes up.

faq: How do I cancel Xfinity internet?
Xfinity's cancel page lists calling 1-800-934-6489, scheduling a call from your account, or visiting an Xfinity Store.
Does Xfinity charge a cancellation fee?

It can if you end service before a minimum term is over. The fee does not apply on a downgrade or when you transfer service to a new Comcast address. Xfinity's 5-year price guarantee page says there is no annual contract and no penalty. We did not find the fee amount published, so ask for it.
How do I return Xfinity equipment?
Hand it to a representative at an Xfinity Store and get a receipt, or send it with a prepaid UPS label from xfinity.com/returns. Allow up to two weeks for the return to show on your account.
Can I lower my bill instead of cancelling?
Often. Ask about a current plan, the 5-year price guarantee and the $10 paperless and autopay credit. See our call script.
